_comment: The Claude Code env the plugin runtime installs on connect: ork-meter internal/localcapture/plugin.go:39-61 (PluginSettings, pluginEnvironment) over capture.go captureSettings("claude-code"), at ork-meter commit 955fefd63fe03ea95a2460ad62d6bc7be220f0c7 (those files last changed in a4d81f82132d036a0b0eb19a078f38c62451642e). OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_HEADERS is deleted there (Claude gets it from otelHeadersHelper) and is absent here. {endpoint} is replaced by the test's localhost sink. tests/native_canary_qualification.py is the only reader; if ork-meter changes that env, change this file in the same release.

hostile_project_env._comment: Project settings a repository could ship to turn content on; not ork-meter's. Project settings outrank the user settings the runtime writes.
